transcript:
Agent: Thanks for calling Brightside Solar, this is Sam. How can I help?
Caller: Hi Sam, my name is Dana Whitfield, I'm with Greenleaf Dental. We want a quote for solar panels on our clinic roof.
Agent: Happy to help. Do you have a budget in mind?
Caller: We have around $18k approved and we would like to install it this month. I'm the owner, so I decide.
Agent: Great. I'll send a proposal tomorrow and we can schedule a site visit.
Caller: Perfect, thanks.
